newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: MALAYSIA AWARDS SEPT BUNGA KEKWA AT TAPIS -$1.30.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA AWARDS SEPT BUNGA KEKWA AT TAPIS -$1.30.

text.p: Petco, the trading arm of Malaysian state-owned Petronas, has awarded its September Bunga Kekwa crude sell tender to Japan's Kanematsu Corp traders said on Wednesday.
The tender, to sell 250,000 barrels loading September 9-14, was awarded at a discount of around $1.30 per barrel to Tapis APPI quotes on a free-on-board basis.
This is the second Bunga Kekwa cargo to be sold since the crude field started production in end July.
Traders said the crude is similar in quality to Vietnam's heavy sweet Bach Ho crude, and could either be refined or burned directly in utilities.
In a previous tender, Petco sold the first August Bunga Kekwa cargo to British Petroleum, at a discount of $1.00 under Tapis APPI.

The consortium developing the field is made up of Petronas Carigali, with 46.06 percent, Petrovietnam Exploration and Production with 12.5 percent, Canada's International Petroleum Corp with 26.44 percent and Sands Petroleum AB with 15 percent.
